findings: Scalar VTCM write followed by HVX load does not show the hypothesized microsecond stall in this fixture.
State-copy plus DDR store costs approximately the same as a register-vector DDR store.
Pack/stem and HMX contain vector stack accesses; depthwise/post do not.
valign and masked stores are faster in microbenchmarks; correctness and full-model speedups require separate qualification.
limitations: Single device/firmware and one graph crop; no broader accuracy or thermal claim.
Phase wrapper totals include fixed overhead on every profiling request; they must not be summed as production native time.
Primitive results time operations and restoration; they do not qualify replacement operator arithmetic.
One timing frame, no statistical claim for end-to-end latency.
